steps.text: Months ago, after contacting Reunion
10:14 P.M. \ Clear
Ursus, unnamed desert outskirts

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...You've met all the Reunion leaders.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: What'd you think?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Are you asking me, or her?

steps.name: W
steps.text: If you ask me, I'd say nothing out of the ordinary. The stuff they do is pretty par for the course for people like that.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: A strange bunch. There's a child who seems to been purposefully pushed into that position to the point of becoming cruel, and then there's a warrior whose toughness is beyond imagination.

steps.name: W
steps.text: There are some incredible people, but then there are also some two-bit villains.

steps.name: W
steps.text: All I can say is, we've seen all kinds of people after fighting wars all these years.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: But, there is someone who caught my eye...

steps.name: W
steps.text: Oh, you must be talking about that one. The one who was waiting at the side with that other little rabbit.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Their squad seemed on a completely different level compared to those ordinary Infected. That kind of Sarkaz warrior can be said to truly bear the mark of war.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Sarkaz...?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Yeah, but you don't see Sarkaz like that every day. He claims to be with Ursus, saying he broke off contact with Kazdel long ago.

steps.name: W
steps.text: How pitiful. He never needed to live such an exhausting life.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Maybe we should all go meet him.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: The impression I got from him... was that he has become much more than a 'warrior.'

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: And you, don't you love thinking about things? Instead of philosophizing, why not have a chat with someone like that?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: We might all learn a lot from him.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You're talking about...
Pardon. I would like to. Speak with you alone.

steps.name: W
steps.text: ...Speak of the devil. What's up?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: To who do I owe the pleasure?
My name. Does not matter. For the time being.
Rest assured. Right now, I am not. Here on behalf of the leader.
I just want to hear...
About my countrymen. About my homeland. What has become of them.
I know that, in Kazdel. Many things happened.
Some things, I have heard. But details, no.

steps.name: W
steps.text: You're just Ursine.
These two identities. Do not conflict.
The bloodline. Has not changed. Dark, and deeply rooted.
I care not for it. But run from it? I cannot.

steps.name: W
steps.text: So even if I told you, what do you plan to do?

steps.name: W
steps.text: These things happened a long time ago for me—
Nothing. There is nothing. I can do.
But, it has been so long. Since I saw Theresa.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Ooh...
From your reactions. I see. She is with you. Her mark is here. After all, you are Sarkaz.
Muddied. Blood-soaked.
She is a hero, at least. So respected. A great warrior. A worthy ruler.
My flesh. Loyal to Ursus. From my people, I exiled myself. But I, am still Sarkaz.
I want to know. What happened to her Kazdel.
I just, want to know.
En route to Chernobog
5:22 A.M. \ Clear
Chernobog, Sarkaz mercenary garrison

steps.name: W
steps.text: ...Need something?

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: We hope that your mercenaries can give us an explanation.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: First, your team defected. The people who went after them reported back that you weren't even trying.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: A few hours ago, some enemies managed to infiltrate Chernobog. Again, due to your negligence.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Combined with the fact that when we first captured Chernobog, someone tipped us off that you let—

steps.name: W
steps.text: Okay, okay, I got it. The client's dissatisfied with our performance. Can you say that with fewer words?

steps.name: W
steps.text: We're simply in a 'cooperative' relationship, and I'm the leader now. If I get on this table and start grovelling, will Talulah be happy?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Or, did having Papa Patriot around give you the illusion... that Reunion is actually good at fighting a war?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Make no mistake about who the people actually capable of bringing you victory are.

steps.name: W
steps.text: If you've figured it out, hurry up and crawl back to that dragon girl. I'll tell her what she wants to know soon enough, so don't rush me.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: There's one other thing.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Just now, stragglers from an enemy party were detected inside the city. That mercenary, Ines, died after exchanging fire with them.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Reunion also participated in this battle. The enemies were very strong, and we all suffered losses.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: This is all due to your negligence.

steps.name: W
steps.text: ...There's no need to get pushy with me.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Seems like something happened to the east of here not long ago.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Precisely.

steps.name: W
steps.text: So... where's the body?

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Unfortunately, I have bad news.

steps.name: W
steps.text: I'm talking about the enemy's corpses. Ines wouldn't use such flashy, destructive Arts.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: Our casters were also involved in the battle. The entire street was destroyed.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Don't you think you're being a bit too blatant here?

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: I don't know what you're talking about.

steps.name: W
steps.text: ...So, from your side's point of view, how should this situation be handled?

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: ...Our main force is focused on the battle that will take place in Lungmen. We have no time to waste here.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: The Leader won't investigate your responsibility in this just yet, so you should handle it yourself.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hmm... You have a pretty thick Ursus accent.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: ...What of it?

steps.name: W
steps.text: You guys...

steps.name: W
steps.text: ...Didn't really think that I'd take some random excuse, did you?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: W, stop.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: (Put that wand away and calm down first.)

steps.name: W
steps.text: Sorry, got a bit carried away there. You can breathe a sigh of relief first and be grateful that you get to live.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: What's the meaning of this?!

steps.name: W
steps.text: ...Don't get me wrong. The death of one Sarkaz won't affect the outcome of the next battle.

steps.name: W
steps.text: And neither will the death of the entire Reunion Movement.

steps.name: W
steps.text: If you don't believe me, you're welcome to try me.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: ...I'll make sure our Leader hears about your true attitude.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: There won't be a next time.

steps.name: W
steps.text: You heard 'em.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Since you let that Rhodes Island squad escape, Reunion has never allowed us to act alone.

steps.name: W
steps.text: If they could put half this much effort into their actual battles, they wouldn't be getting their asses handed to them so badly.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Despite that, you still deliberately let that traitorous blademaster get away.

steps.name: W
steps.text: ...I didn't deliberately let him go. I just didn't want those idiotic Infected to kill a Sarkaz I brought here.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...The old you would've slaughtered Flamebringer on the spot to get Reunion's attention off of you.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Regardless of what you wanted.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Eh? Was I the only one who couldn't remember his codename? How embarrassing.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: So, is Ines really...

steps.name: W
steps.text: Now's not the time...

steps.name: W
steps.text: She... I'll have someone identify her, identify her c— ...Tch.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Let's talk business first.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...Three things.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: First, Ines wanted to warn you that something's wrong with Talulah. She must've seen something more specific, but I'm not clear on that.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: All she told me was, Talulah apparently had 'two shadows.' From her reaction, this isn't some common byproduct of Arts interference.

steps.name: W
steps.text: That damn coward... Why wouldn't she ever be straightforward...

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Second, the old man has left. Received an order to go fetch something. Talulah didn't even make any efforts to hide it.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...Finally, a messenger has already set off for Victoria. Shortly, the Regent will know everything that has happened here.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Theresis knows many things, and he has just as many monsters around him.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: If he is allowed to intervene, this would no longer be a simple question between Reunion and Ursus...

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: W! Are you listening to me?

steps.name: W
steps.text: ...Too noisy. Since it's all good news anyway, let me have some peace and quiet.

steps.name: W
steps.text: You've had your hand on the hilt of your blade... ever since you walked through the door.

steps.name: W
steps.text: You were like that when we first met, as if you were ready to cut me down at any moment.

steps.name: W
steps.text: But the way you stayed calm back there was just like Patriot—

steps.name: W
steps.text: What do you really think about this?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: That's not important.

steps.name: W
steps.text: And none of us are. We all know this, and bad habits die hard.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Ines, she...

steps.name: W
steps.text: I have the right to hear what she said, right? ...In order to respect her sacrifice.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...You two are both similar. Never considering the consequences of the things you do.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: The Regent will not sit idly and watch them lose control. If you can't give him a suitable answer, Londinium's summons will destroy everything you've painstakingly put together.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Ironically, I still don't know what you're trying to accomplish, even now.

steps.name: W
steps.text: ...Who knows?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Just, don't think you can handle everything alone, W. You'll come to regret it sooner or later, just like me.

steps.name: W
steps.text: The reason you have the right to ask questions is because you avoided the center of the whirlpool.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Really? Who's still left on Rhodes Island now?

steps.name: W
steps.text: ...Why are you asking that?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I've seen your interactions with the messenger. You've been investigating Rhodes Island's trail.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: That drug company... I had assumed they only got caught up in that war, but turns out, the truth isn't so simple.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Especially, Scout...

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...According to your plan, we were in charge of all the other fronts during the battle to hold Chernobog.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Yeah, and you guys did a great job—

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: But, someone still found him, the ghost of Babel. You chose to find him yourself, and then you let him go.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: In the past, I would've seen this as a sign of untrustworthiness.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: But by the looks of things, you didn't plan to keep that secret for long anyway.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Ugh, what point is there in hiding that?

steps.name: W
steps.text: If you've ever fought in a battle, you're bound to know some people who have a bit of a reputation.

steps.name: W
steps.text: After all, if those people have been fighting tooth and nail to hang on, there's no getting around it.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: What's your plan now? We shouldn't have had to fight against them in the first place.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: If that Kal'tsit is still in charge of Rhodes Island,  this might be a chance...

steps.name: W
steps.text: No.

steps.name: W
steps.text: What do you think my objective is?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...I see.

steps.name: W
steps.text: You said you'd help me do this one thing. We agreed on it.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Dishonest mercenaries are worth just as much as dead mercenaries, so I don't mind making some extra arrangements.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Ines can no longer help you.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: And soon... I'll have to leave too.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Oh, I haven't heard about this before. Where to?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I'll head back to Victoria with the messenger. It'll be about a three or four-month trip. We'll leave tomorrow morning before sunrise.

steps.name: W
steps.text: ...Are you in that much of a hurry to reunite with Ines in death? With your reputation, you plan to head back to Londinium carrying all that sin on your shoulders?

steps.name: W
steps.text: You'd probably be better off fleeing back to Kazdel.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You killed Garcin and reorganized the mercenaries. Someone has to report this to the Regent.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: If nobody goes to report this, he'll treat us like disowned children and cast us straight into the next warzone. A battlefield within his reach.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: When that time comes, there really will be no place to run.

steps.name: W
steps.text: You're taking this risk to cover for me? Why would you do that?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Her Majesty, Theresa... She remembered my name. And my family.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Though Her Majesty is no longer here, there's a part of her left in this piece of shit, no good squad.

steps.name: W
steps.text: How come I've never seen it?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Mm. No matter how perverse the Sarkaz's personalities and methods may be, judging from the results, they're still fighting for that lofty, unrealistic idea.

steps.name: W
steps.text: ...Do you even know what you're talking about?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: We've known each other for a long time, W.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: That's all.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Out of compassion, let me also give you a reminder.

steps.name: W
steps.text: This is your best opportunity to escape Kazdel. Leave from here, past Lungmen and Ursus, to the distant lands beyond. I'm willing to keep one eye closed.

steps.name: W
steps.text: But if you go back, know that you will die.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Hah... Just earlier, you said you wanted me to help you do your thing.

steps.name: W
steps.text: If your idea of helping me is just committing suicide, then I suggest you hang on to your life instead.

steps.name: W
steps.text: When it's my turn to collect, I'd like some of my debtors to still be alive.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I wouldn't necessarily be going there to die. Depending on the Regent's mood, there are many possible outcomes.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Reunion has been manipulated into something far beyond what you can imagine. The Regent may well change his mind.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...In any case, I no longer have the luxury of running away.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I've left Kazdel. And I'm about to leave here. What's the worst that could happen? Patriot has already taught me enough.

steps.name: W
steps.text: You've been influenced by him a lot, just from your short time here.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Just like you were, with Theresa. It's all the same, isn't it?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Theresis sits on his throne. Even if I am only able to grovel my way up there with my head pressed against the ground, I must reach where he is, and figure out what he is thinking.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Otherwise, if we continue acting recklessly as we are now, that will truly be committing suicide.

steps.name: W
steps.text: You know, you could also just submit to him.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I've thought about that before. Just so you know, Garcin was always suspicious of you. He even gave me the order to kill you once.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Oh? Sounds like things would've been a bit more entertaining if you had listened to him.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Sorry, but I'm not into the same kind of stuff you're into.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Now, let's decide.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hm... I won't deny that I'm curious about what Theresis is up to.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Seems like I have no choice though.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: That's right. Even if you rejected my proposal, I don't plan to let you keep running the show.

steps.name: W
steps.text: You're not gonna say that this is for my good, right?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Of course not. What kind of Sarkaz goes around taking care of others?

steps.name: W
steps.text: ...How disappointing, you've just gone right back to your old ways. I thought you were going to keep falling.

steps.name: W
steps.text: So, do you already have a plan?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Why don't you go ask Ines?

steps.name: W
steps.text: That's a really unfunny joke.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Then, before I leave, let me tell you another joke.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Ines once told me that you looked more and more like a lunatic, but your actions got less and less decisive.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Who, me? Do you really believe that?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Have I been using fewer bombs recently?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Maybe. No matter how good you might be at hiding it, we've worked together for far too many years.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Who's to say, maybe we trusted you this whole time.

steps.name: W
steps.text: ...So, which line was the joke?

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: ...Oh, it's you. Sarkaz mercenary, Hoederer, huh?

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: I heard you were leaving. What business do you have with us?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Before I leave, there's something I'd like to confirm...

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Did any of you personally see Ines fall in battle?

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: As soon as we received the support request, the battle was over.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: The street had been torn apart, and the Originium crystals left by the Catastrophe caused a violent chain reaction.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: We got the situation under control with fairly minimal—

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: ...What are you doing?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Ursursian, you're pretty calm for someone who just saw a companion fall in front of your eyes.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You give off the stench of conspiracy and war. A stench that is all too familiar—

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: If Ines was still here, that's definitely what she'd say.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: So that's what this is about. It's all too common for people to vent their anger on the Infected over a fallen comrade.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: I just thought you would've been a little smarter than W.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...A little smarter, huh?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Yeah, looking back, I've been a bit overprotective of her. Always have been.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: But not because I was afraid she'd get in trouble. You see, I was more afraid that I'd have nobody to kill.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: After all, I'm also a Sarkaz... the real deal.

steps.name: Reunion Soldier
steps.text: You——!
